```{=html}
<!--

is Stage 3 of the USGS pipeline, not Stage 1. Run order:

  1. master_analysis_usgs_FIXED.Rmd -> master_usgs.csv (raw cleaning only)
  2. usgs_elevation_and_z_star.qmd (reads master_usgs.csv) -> usgs_elev_z_flux.csv
  3. THIS FILE (reads usgs_elev_z_flux.csv) -> usgs_bay.csv, usgs_river.csv

Previously all three stages lived in one file, with Stage 3 reading
back a file (usgs_elev_z_flux.csv) that didn't exist until Stage 2 ran
-- meaning "run master_analysis_usgs_FIXED.Rmd" secretly meant
"run half of it, go run a different file, then come back." The
read-back line also had a real bug independent of the ordering issue:
it read.csv()'d the usgs_elevation_and_z_star.qmd SCRIPT FILE itself
(wrong path, wrong file type), not its usgs_elev_z_flux.csv output --
fixed in the chunk below.

Needs its own package/path setup since it's now a standalone
entry point, not a continuation of another file's already-loaded
session.
-->
```

```{r, read back the elevation-joined data}
# Replaces sed_usgs for everything downstream -- carries Elevation_m,
# z_star, and Marsh_Loc (bay/channel, reference only) into the
# Bay/River split and every plot/model built on sed_usgs_bay /
# sed_usgs_river below.
sed_usgs <- readr::read_csv("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\usgs_elev_z_flux.csv") %>%
mutate(Flux_rep = Flux)

# FIX: this used to read.csv() the usgs_elevation_and_z_star.qmd SCRIPT
# FILE itself (wrong path -- code\\data_prep\\, not data\\; wrong file
# type -- a .qmd script isn't a CSV of sediment data). That would error
# immediately, or if it somehow didn't, return nonsense. This now reads
# usgs_elev_z_flux.csv, which is what usgs_elevation_and_z_star.qmd
# actually writes -- readr::read_csv() rather than base read.csv() so
# Date.placed.in.field/Date.removed.from.field come back as proper Date
# columns, same reasoning used elsewhere in this pipeline (e.g.
# usgs_thesis_merge.qmd).

# Dist got written out as numeric by usgs_elevation_and_z_star.qmd's
# join step -- restore the factor type/level order the rest of this
# file (Marsh_Area case_when, the final Dist releveling) expects.
sed_usgs <- sed_usgs %>%
  mutate(Dist = as.character(Dist)) %>%
  mutate(Dist = factor(Dist, levels = c("0.5", "2", "6", "9", "12", "18", "24", "30", "48", "72", "150")))

# Bay adjacent transects A and B directly comparable to thesis

sed_usgs_bay <- sed_usgs %>% 
  filter(Tran %in% c("A", "B")) %>%
  mutate(
    Marsh_Area = case_when (
    Site == "CorteMadera" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("0.5", "2", "6") ~ "Edge", 
    Site == "CorteMadera" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("12", "18", "24") ~ "Platform", 
    Site == "CorteMadera" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("30", "48") ~ "Upland", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("0.5", "2", "6", "9", "12", "18") ~ "Intertidal", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("24") ~ "Edge", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("48") ~ "Platform", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("A", "B") & Dist %in% c("72", "150") ~ "Upland", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ), 
  Marsh_Area = factor(Marsh_Area, levels = c("Intertidal", "Edge", "Platform", "Upland")) 
  )

sed_usgs_bay <- sed_usgs_bay %>%
  mutate(Dist = factor(Dist, levels = c("0.5", "2", "6", "9", "12", "18", "24", "30", "48", "72", "150")))

# river database

sed_usgs_river <- sed_usgs %>% 
  filter(Tran %in% c("C", "D")) %>%
  mutate(
    Marsh_Area = case_when (
    Site == "CorteMadera" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("0.5", "2", "6") ~ "Edge", 
    Site == "CorteMadera" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("12", "18", "24") ~ "Platform", 
    Site == "CorteMadera" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("30", "48") ~ "Upland", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("0.5", "2", "6", "9", "12", "18") ~ "Intertidal", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("24") ~ "Edge", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("48") ~ "Platform", 
    Site == "SanPablo" & Tran %in% c("C", "D") & Dist %in% c("72", "150") ~ "Upland", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ), 
  Marsh_Area = factor(Marsh_Area, levels = c("Intertidal", "Edge", "Platform", "Upland")) 
  )

sed_usgs_river <- sed_usgs_river %>%
  mutate(Dist = factor(Dist, levels = c("0.5", "2", "6", "9", "12", "18", "24", "30", "48", "72", "150")))

# right after the split, BEFORE average_replicates() is called
sed_usgs_river_raw <- sed_usgs_river
sed_usgs_bay_raw   <- sed_usgs_bay

average_replicates <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Site, Tran, Dist, Date.removed.from.field, Study.Phase) %>%
    summarise(
      Flux = mean(Flux_rep, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_reps = sum(!is.na(Flux_rep)),
      Elevation_m = mean(Elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE), 
      z_star = mean(z_star, na.rm = TRUE), 
      across(-c(Flux_rep, Flux, Replicate, Elevation_m, z_star), first),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sed_usgs_bay   <- sed_usgs_bay   %>% average_replicates()
sed_usgs_river <- sed_usgs_river %>% average_replicates()

sed_usgs_bay <- sed_usgs_bay %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(month(Date.removed.from.field, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                         levels = c("July","August","September","October","November",
                                    "December","January","February","March","April","May","June"),
                         ordered = TRUE))

sed_usgs_river <- sed_usgs_river %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(month(Date.removed.from.field, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                         levels = c("July","August","September","October","November",
                                    "December","January","February","March","April","May","June"),
                         ordered = TRUE))

# Confirm the split adds up to the original row count, no overlap/loss
nrow(sed_usgs_bay) + nrow(sed_usgs_river) == nrow(sed_usgs)
sed_usgs_bay %>% count(n_reps)
sed_usgs_river %>% count(n_reps)
sed_usgs_bay %>% count(n_reps)     # USGS

# Confirm no unexpected NAs snuck through (would mean a Dist value
# wasn't covered in your case_when, e.g. a typo or a value you forgot)
sed_usgs_bay %>% filter(is.na(Marsh_Area)) %>% count(Site, Dist)
sed_usgs_river %>% filter(is.na(Marsh_Area)) %>% count(Site, Dist)


```

```{r, usgs plots}
# make_sed_plots_usgs_bay() and the local save_sed_plots() are gone --
# both replaced by the shared versions in R/plotting.R (sourced above).
#
# This also fixes three real bugs that were in make_sed_plots_usgs_bay():
#   1. It ignored its own `data` and `title_suffix` arguments and always
#      used the global sed_usgs_bay directly.
#   2. An orphaned, unnamed labs() call (leftover from a commented-out
#      z* plot) was sitting inside the returned list -- save_sed_plots()
#      would error on it the moment this ran end-to-end.
#   3. season_usgs / site_season_usgs referenced a `Season` column that
#      doesn't exist anywhere in this file's data -- would have errored
#      with "object 'Season' not found". Looks like leftover code from
#      master_analysis_thesis.Rmd, which does have a Season column.
#      Dropped rather than ported, since Season isn't part of this
#      pipeline's data. Flag if you actually want a Season breakdown --
#      it'd need to be derived here first, then could be added to
#      make_sed_plots() as a conditional block (same pattern as the
#      z_star -> elev_site block already in there).

all_plots_usgs <- make_sed_plots(sed_usgs_bay, title_suffix = " (USGS)")

# View any individual plot the same way you would have before:
all_plots_usgs$basic
all_plots_usgs$phase_site_log
all_plots_usgs$dist_edge

images_folder <- "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\usgsdata"
# NOTE: this intentionally overrides the general images_folder that
# R/plotting.R sets when sourced -- USGS output goes to its own
# subfolder. Keep this override AFTER the source() calls at the top.

save_sed_plots(all_plots_usgs, images_folder, "sed_usgs_bay")

# to check for seasonality differences throughout the marsh areas of one site 

marsharea_seasonality <- sed_usgs_bay %>% 
  filter(Site == "SanPablo") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = Flux, color = Marsh_Area)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = ("Sediment Flux Over Time by Marsh Area at San Pablo, 2022-2023"),
    subtitle = "Each panel = one site; color = Marsh Area",
    x = "Time", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Marsh Area"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
marsharea_seasonality

ggsave(("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\usgsdata\\marsharea_seasonality_SP.png"),
       plot = marsharea_seasonality,
       width = 10,  
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white"
)
```

```{r, usgs statistics}
# Mirrors the make_flux_table() pattern from master_analysis_cleanup.Rmd

general_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay,
  title = "Summary Statistics for Sediment Flux (USGS)",
  include_ci = TRUE
)
general_summary_usgs <- general_result_usgs$data

phen_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = "Phen_Period",
  title = "Sediment Flux by Phenological Period (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Phen_Period = "Phenological Period")
)
phen_summary_usgs <- phen_result_usgs$data

site_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = "Site",
  title = "Sediment Flux by Site (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Site = "Site")
)
site_summary_usgs <- site_result_usgs$data

# Original filtered out NA Date.removed.from.field rows before grouping --
# make_flux_table() doesn't do this internally, so it's done here first,
# matching the original chunk's behavior exactly.
phase_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay %>% filter(!is.na(Date.removed.from.field)),
  group_vars = "Date.removed.from.field",
  title = "Sediment Flux by Date Removed From Field (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Date.removed.from.field = "Date Removed From Field")
)
phase_summary_table_usgs <- phase_result_usgs$data

dist_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = "Dist",
  title = "Sediment Flux by Distance (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Dist = "Distance")
)
dist_summary_usgs <- dist_result_usgs$data

zstar_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = "z_star",
  title = "Sediment Flux by Z-star (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(z_star = "Z-star")
)
zstar_summary_usgs <- zstar_result_usgs$data

month_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = "Month",
  title = "Sediment Flux by Month (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Month = "Month")
)
month_summary_usgs <- month_result_usgs$data

dist_site_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = c("Site", "Dist"),
  title = "Sediment Flux by Site and Distance (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Site = "Site", Dist = "Distance")
)
dist_site_summary_usgs <- dist_site_result_usgs$data

zstar_site_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = c("Site", "z_star"),
  title = "Sediment Flux by Site and Z-star (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Site = "Site", z_star = "Z-star")
)
zstar_site_summary_usgs <- zstar_site_result_usgs$data

month_site_result_usgs <- make_flux_table(
  sed_usgs_bay, group_vars = c("Site", "Month"),
  title = "Sediment Flux by Site and Month (USGS)",
  group_labels = list(Site = "Site", Month = "Month")
)
month_site_summary_usgs <- month_site_result_usgs$data

general_summary_usgs
phen_summary_usgs
site_summary_usgs
phase_summary_table_usgs

sed_usgs_bay %>% count(n_reps)


```

```{r}
ggplot(
  sed_usgs_bay,
  aes(
    Dist,
    Flux
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal()

usgs_dist_summary <- sed_usgs_bay %>%
  group_by(Site, Dist) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  usgs_dist_summary,
  aes(
    x = Dist,
    y = mean_flux
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_flux - se_flux,
      ymax = mean_flux + se_flux
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from Marsh Edge (m)",
    y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day))
  )


usgs_phase_summary <- sed_usgs_bay %>%
  group_by(Date.removed.from.field) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n())
  )

ggplot(usgs_phase_summary,
       aes(Date.removed.from.field, mean_flux)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_flux - se_flux,
      ymax = mean_flux + se_flux
    ),
    width = 0.2
  )
```
